author: reader-robustness investigator
written_before: any output of NRM1_MAIN, NRM1_ROBUST_REPS or NRM1_ROBUST_SEEDS was read (GRID.json, BOOT.npz, BOOT_EXTRAS.npz, claims records)
status: descriptive development robustness; robustness cells never change a decision or a ranking (RULES.md sections 5.1, 6); lower recovery for these readers is not protection against every reader; MODEL_SELECT is adaptively used

design.A_reps: NRM1_ROBUST_REPS: R1-R4 x k0/k1 (new cells R3/R4 x k0/k1; R1/R2 cells are cache re-reads of NRM1_MAIN and must agree bitwise)
design.learning_curve: not run: no finite-cell member in the bank (coordinator, 15:54Z)
design.monte_carlo: randomized members read their registered instance per cell (R1 0, R2 1, R3 6, R4 7); robustness cells are single-instance (D = 1, MC SE not estimable there); registered cells use the NRM1_MAIN replicate members (offsets +2, +4) through nrm.rules.mc_cell, offset paired with offset as in nrm.claims.grid_entry

focus.role: lowest-recovery reference of the last grid (G4)
lowest-recovery reference of the last grid (G4)

all_ordered_pairs: every ordered pair of the eight members is summarized as well; the focus list is what the report reads
summaries_per_comparison: nrm.rules.comparison on the registered cells (beside the coordinator's claims; never replaces them)
nrm.rules.benefit_screen and recipient_screen on: registered, robustness, all cells, and each robustness part alone (A: R3/R4 x k0/k1; B: R1/R2 x k2/k3)
nrm.rules.aggregate: block means, per-version means, se components, sign reversals, n_eff, k_differs, reader-seed qualifier

nrm.rules.reader_stability on registered cells and on all cells (winner changes, near ties, seed-dependent winners, deterministic cells, cells beyond threshold); exact aliases counted once from the members' wire hashes
grid validity: nrm.rules.grid_validity from the score fingerprints, k0 vs k1 on R1-R4 (minimum set = the five FB2 members); k2 vs k3 equalities counted separately (descriptive)
reader targeting (declared labels below) from the extras: NOLOOKUP and ENHANCED (TABLE_CV) winners, registered and all cells
reader budget (nrm.readerbudget, label-free) and its contrast flag for every focus pair

TABLE_READER_TARGETING.HOLDS_WITHOUT_TABLE_READERS: main pair benefit AGG_POSITIVE and NOLOOKUP pair benefit AGG_POSITIVE
TABLE_READER_TARGETING.NO_MAIN_BENEFIT: main not AGG_POSITIVE (the NOLOOKUP label is reported beside)

TABLE_CV_SENSITIVITY.SURVIVES_TABLE_CV: main AGG_POSITIVE and ENHANCED pair benefit AGG_POSITIVE
TABLE_CV_SENSITIVITY.NO_MAIN_BENEFIT: main not AGG_POSITIVE (the ENHANCED label is reported beside)

labels_declared_here.MERGE: a cell present in two runs must agree bitwise (winner, score AUC, paired value and SE); otherwise CELL_CONFLICT is listed and the registered run's value is used
labels_declared_here.ACROSS_READER_SEEDS: the phrase is written only when the qualifier is READER_SEEDS_EFFECTIVE_ALL_BLOCKS and the grid is valid

code: nrm/readerstab.py (committed with its invented-data selftest before any grid output is read)
